h: MultiChoice reportedly confirms cheaper DStv decoders and subscription prices
p: MultiChoice has reportedly taken a final decision to reduce the prices of DStv decoders and subscription packages in Nigeria. The company is said to have not yet published every new price, so customers are advised to check before renewing.
more: The cut is said to follow months of complaints about subscription costs.
Full package-by-package prices are still awaited.
